source: Energy Performance of Buildings Data — domestic certificates (bulk CSV full load)
coverage_statement: ~80 to 82% of dwellings have an EPC
coverage: England & Wales. EPCs have accumulated since ~2008 (every sale, letting and new build), reaching roughly 80-82% of dwellings by 2026. Stated as a band because the point figure (national_coverage_estimate) is spuriously precise for an accumulation-based measure with a ~1.7% address-matched tail; national_coverage_uprn_only is the exact-match floor. Use coveragePerHousehold per code for local detail.
dedupe: latest certificate per property (UPRN where present, else normalised postcode+address1). UPRN dedupe is exact; the address fallback can only over-count unique properties (inflating coverage), never under-count.
scotland_note: Scotland has a separate EPC register (Scottish Government); not processed. Northern Ireland (BT) has no boundary geometry in v6.
